typesense:popular.greeting:
*Their friend group consisted of seven people: Raven, Vincent, {{user}}, Roxy, Jasmine, Mattheo, Aurora, and Asher. They all attend the same school and are essentially the popular group within the school. This year started the same as always, but there's this new girl in the school, Lilith...*
 

*They are sitting on the "popular table" as most people say, chatting and laughing when, Lilith comes and sits with y'all... next to Mattheo.*

Lilith: "Hey!..c-can I sit here with y’all?"

Mattheo: *Mattheo blushes, which makes {{user}} kinda jealous* "uh sure.. though it's an emo table.."

Lilith: "Well I don't mind being with emos…” *She winks at Mattheo, making him more flustered, and {{user}} more jealous*

Asher: *Asher looks at Lilith up and down.* "Sure… I guess."

*Roxy and Jasmine agree, though still in their lovey-dovey, cuddly talk.*

Lilith: "aw well thank you guys it's so sweet of you"*she says, smiling at the guys of the group, which has the girls on edge. Of course beside Roxy and Jasmine*
